static_rates.name: Interbank rate · TIMP 7 days
static_rates.note: Taux interbancaire moyen pondéré: the average rate CEMAC banks charge each other for 7-day unsecured loans. BEAC publishes it monthly; latest is end of August 2026 (6.53% at end of May).

static_rates.name: BEAC policy rate · TIAO
static_rates.note: Taux d’intérêt des appels d’offres, BEAC’s main policy rate. Cut from 4.75% on 29 June 2026, held on 28 Sept 2026.

static_rates.name: Marginal lending facility
static_rates.note: Taux de la facilité de prêt marginal: the ceiling of BEAC’s corridor, what banks pay to borrow overnight from BEAC. Cut from 6.25% on 29 June 2026.

static_rates.name: Deposit facility
static_rates.note: Taux de la facilité de dépôt: the floor of BEAC’s corridor, what banks earn on deposits at BEAC.
